title: Double-Charge Held-Capture Rate for Finch Circle Members with a Marlowe & Finch Card — Merchandise Purchases
content:
On a refund of a second capture of a Merchandise Purchases unit's payment, the daily held-capture rate of a customer who holds an active card in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program is set by the tier of the customer's active Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership:

| Active Finch Circle tier | Active Marlowe & Finch card held | Daily held-capture rate |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Icon | Yes | top rate, $0.75 per day |
| Member or Silver | Yes | base rate, $0.40 per day |

Both parts of a row must hold. A customer with no active membership, or holding no active Marlowe & Finch card, is outside this schedule.

*Hypothetical:* over 14 held-capture days, the top rate comes to $10.50 and the base rate to $5.60, before any cap.
